name: io.github.ms-methos/jsonfabrica-mcp-server
title: JsonFabrica
description: Generate realistic, relational synthetic JSON test data from templates, via the JsonFabrica API.

environmentVariables.name: JSONFABRICA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: JsonFabrica API key. Create one at jsonfabrica.com -> Settings -> API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: JSONFABRICA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the JsonFabrica gateway. Override only when self-hosting the gateway.
